newsitem.title: ITALY: Italy issues 30-yr bond with 7.25pct coupon.
newsitem.headline: Italy issues 30-yr bond with 7.25pct coupon.

text.p: The Italian Treasury said on Thursday it was offering a new issue 30-year fixed rate bond (BTP) paying a coupon of 7.25 percent.
The November 1, 1996 paper will be sold at the Treasury's regular, end of month auction.
The Treasury last placed a 30-year BTP on the market in 1993 but it soon stopped re-opening the issue.
The Treasury said on Thursday it would also offer a new issue 10-year BTP, dated February 1, 1997 and paying a first coupon of 6.75 percent against a previous 7.75 percent.
The Treasury said in a statement said it would offer at its forthcoming auctions:
* 5th tranche 1/1/97 3-yr BTPs paying a 6.0 percent coupon.
* 1st tranche 1/2/97 10-yr BTP paying a 6.75 percent coupon.
* 1st tranche 1/11/96 30-yr BTP paying a 7.25 percent coupon
* 3rd tranche 1/1/97 7-yr CCTs paying an initial 3.45 pct coupon.
The amount of paper offered will be announced on January 27.
